title: Design Day Bangalore #24 — Future by Design
description:
The theme for October 2014's Design Day is:

Future by Design

After the last few decades of living a knowledge and information driven life, the world is at the threshold of a new era - The Creative Era. The signs are already visible today. The action will start tomorrow. It will get bigger in the days to come.
Future by Design aims at opening up minds and start a conversation.

Due to logistical issues we would need to limit the number of participants to the first 50 Registrations and you will receive a confirmation email if your registration request is accepted - First come First Serve basis.

The agenda includes:
1. Design Story: By an experienced designer to walk us through the trials and tribulations of a career in Design.

2. A Case Study/Skill Building Session: By an experienced Designer to teach us something new.

3. A JAM: You will be given a topic and would have to come up with some design suggestions based on that topic in 2 hours. This is a group activity, where participants are split into groups of 4-5 people. We will have markers, sketchpens and chart papers for your use.

This event is strictly for designers. Its fine if you are a beginner and want to learn.

Cheers,

Amit/Ahmed/Aashish
